main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 5-day excess return on forecast (grid bars, forecast < 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and mean excess < 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean 5-day excess return on the same bars below 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: The profile is read from the regime column (regime 'unknown', no veto fired) and the fall from the sign of the raw scaled 30-day return; holding is the coin's mean 5-day return over its non-overlapping grid of all windows, and the plan's minimum of 30 grid bars is applied as 'not observable'.
